title: config: fix duplicate cgroup warning
body:
If you run Podman as a normal user without a proper login session, it prints a warning that there is no systemd session and it uses cgroupfs instead. From the second run on, Podman starts two copies of itself. The first copy starts the second copy to join the background helper process, so both copies print the warning and the user sees it twice.

Now the first copy prints the warning and then leaves a small note in its environment, _CONTAINERS_CGROUP_MANAGER_WARNED=1. The second copy sees the warning was already shown and skips it. Both copies still switch to cgroupfs, so behavior is unchanged, only the duplicate message is gone.

The test calls the same function twice and checks the warning text appears once.
On my WSL, before the fix runs two to four show the warning 2 times each, after the fix 1 time.

Fixes podman-container-tools/podman#24004
